SHUYU_CARD_MO_LI_XIAN_DAN.title: Magic Buckshot
SHUYU_CARD_BENG_LIE.title: Fracture
SHUYU_CARD_BENG_LIE.description:
Whenever an enemy triggers [gold]Break[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage to it. Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage and apply {FragilePower:diff()} [gold]Fragile[/gold] to ALL other enemies.
Apply 2 [gold]Fragile[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SHUYU_CARD_BING_YUE.title: Ice Moon
SHUYU_CARD_BING_YUE.description:
Whenever you apply a [gold]Debuff[/gold], gain {IceShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
Gain {ExtraIceShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
SHUYU_CARD_WAN_BI_BU_PO.title: Unbroken Perfection
SHUYU_CARD_WAN_BI_BU_PO.description: Damage taken and HP lost this turn are reduced to 0. When you would take attack damage, the attacker takes the damage you would have taken.
SHUYU_CARD_BING_JI_LI.title: Ice Caltrops
SHUYU_CARD_NI_ZHUAN_JIE_JIE.title: Inversion Barrier
SHUYU_CARD_NI_ZHUAN_JIE_JIE.description:
Gain {IceThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Thorns[/gold] and {IceShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
Swap the amounts of your [gold]Ice Thorns[/gold] and [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
SHUYU_CARD_YU_ZHI_LI_CHANG.title: Prefabricated Field
SHUYU_CARD_YU_ZHI_LI_CHANG.description:
Gain {IceThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Thorns[/gold] and {IceShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
At the start of combat, lose {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, play this card automatically, then return it to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Whenever you play this card manually, permanently increase its [gold]Ice Thorns[/gold] and [gold]Ice Shield[/gold] by {Increase:diff()}.
SHUYU_CARD_ZHI_HUAN_SHU_SHI.title: Transposition Formula
SHUYU_CARD_ZHI_HUAN_SHU_SHI.description:
Whenever the enemy triggers [gold]Break[/gold] this turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Apply [gold]Frozen[/gold] to up to 5 cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Apply that much [gold]Fragile[/gold] to the enemy.
SHUYU_CARD_QIAN_MIAN_JING_LANG.title: Hall of Mirrors
SHUYU_CARD_QIAN_MIAN_JING_LANG.descripti:
Whenever you gain [gold]Ice Thorns[/gold], ALL other players gain the same amount.
Gain {IceThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Thorns[/gold].
SHUYU_CARD_JIN_SHU_JIE_JIE.title: Forbidden Art: Barrier
SHUYU_CARD_JIN_SHU_JIE_JIE.description:
Gain {IceShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
Add a [gold]Misfortune[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Whenever you take more than 0 attack damage, lose 1 additional [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
SHUYU_CARD_TIAO_HE_SHU_SHI.title: Harmonizing Formula
SHUYU_CARD_TIAO_HE_SHU_SHI.description:
Add a [gold]Triple Point+[/gold] into the [gold]Hand[/gold] of ALL players.
It has [gold]Retain[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: and [purple]Sown[/purple]}.
SHUYU_CARD_BING_SHAN_YI_JIAO.title: Tip of the Iceberg
SHUYU_CARD_BING_SHAN_YI_JIAO.description:
Gain {IceShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
Transfer one-third of your [gold]Ice Shield[/gold] to another player.
SHUYU_CARD_JIU_CHAN_ZHI_SHU.title: Entanglement Tome
SHUYU_CARD_JIU_CHAN_ZHI_SHU.description:
At the start of combat, add a copy of this card into the [gold]Hand[/gold] of other players.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times, then ALL other players return their [gold]Entanglement Tome[/gold] to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Frostforged[/gold]: ALL players' [gold]Entanglement Tomes[/gold] hit 1 additional time.
SHUYU_CARD_JIU_CHAN_XU_YUAN_SHU.title: Entangled Wishbook
SHUYU_CARD_JIU_CHAN_XU_YUAN_SHU.descript:
At the start of combat, add a copy of this card into the [gold]Hand[/gold] of ALL other players.
Choose a wish to fulfill, then ALL other players return their [gold]Entangled Wishbook[/gold] to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
After {CanUseTimes:diff()} uses, remove this for the rest of combat and add a [gold]Misfortune[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHUYU_CARD_WISH_STRENGTH.title: Might Beyond Measure
SHUYU_CARD_WISH_STRENGTH.description:
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Upgrade the [gold]Might Beyond Measure[/gold] option in ALL players' [gold]Entangled Wishbooks[/gold] once this combat.
SHUYU_CARD_WISH_SHIELD.title: Eternal Life
SHUYU_CARD_WISH_SHIELD.description:
Gain {IceShieldPower:diff()} [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
Upgrade the [gold]Eternal Life[/gold] option in ALL players' [gold]Entangled Wishbooks[/gold] once this combat.
SHUYU_CARD_WISH_GOLD.title: Fame and Fortune
SHUYU_CARD_WISH_GOLD.description:
Gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
Upgrade the [gold]Fame and Fortune[/gold] option in ALL players' [gold]Entangled Wishbooks[/gold] once this combat.
